ios.desc: Stay on track with your daily calorie goals and compete with friends using our app. With our intuitive visualizations and a range of motivating widgets, you'll be able to easily track your progress and stay motivated to reach your fitness goals. All you need to get started is to connect Daily Cals to the Apple Health app.

quotes.text:
Daily Cals: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-cals/id1614789690

An iOS App that provides a visualization of how often you hit your daily exercise goals and compete with friends (using data transferred through gamekit) I initially launched the app at $2 and hit the brick wall that is paid app user acquisition. I lowered the price to free for a bit to see if it catches on at all.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Those making $0/month or less on side projects – Show and tell
